sloka: प्रभातायाम् तु शर्वर्याम् पौराः ते राघवो विना ।शोक उपहत निश्चेष्टा बभूवुर् हत चेतसः ॥२-४७-१॥
transliteration: prabhātāyām tu śarvaryām paurāḥ te rāghavo vinā ।śoka upahata niśceṣṭā babhūvur hata cetasaḥ ॥2-47-1॥

translations.english: When the night advanced towards dawn the citizens were stunned not to see the scion of the Raghus (Rama). Overwhelmed with sorrow they lost their senses.
